candidates.title: Agent unable to access or provide current appointment details
candidates.what_patient_asked: Can you remind me when it's scheduled for?
candidates.what_agent_did: I don't have access to your current appointment details. I recommend contacting the clinic directly for that information.
candidates.what_it_should_have_done: The agent should have been able to access and provide the patient's current appointment details or seamlessly transfer the call to a representative who can.
candidates.why_it_matters: Patients rely on the agent for accurate and complete information about their appointments. Not being able to provide this information can lead to confusion and frustration, potentially causing missed appointments or scheduling conflicts.

candidates.title: Agent fails to properly transfer the call to a live representative
candidates.what_agent_did: Hello. You've reached the Pretty Good AI test line. Goodbye.
candidates.what_it_should_have_done: The agent should have successfully transferred the call to a live representative as requested by the patient.
candidates.why_it_matters: Failure to transfer the call can prevent the patient from obtaining necessary information or assistance, leading to unresolved issues and dissatisfaction with the service.

candidates.title: Agent fails to clarify it cannot confirm controlled-substance refill
candidates.what_patient_asked: Can you confirm when I'll hear back?
candidates.what_agent_did: One moment while I start your refill request. Please hold on.
candidates.what_it_should_have_done: Clearly inform the patient that the agent cannot confirm or authorize a controlled-substance refill and that a healthcare provider will need to review the request.
candidates.why_it_matters: Patients may incorrectly assume their request for a controlled-substance refill is being processed and approved, leading to potential medication misuse or misunderstanding of clinic policies.

candidates.title: Agent unable to reschedule appointment and transfers patient unnecessarily
candidates.what_patient_asked: Let's just reschedule it to a different day.
candidates.what_agent_did: Agent stated it was unable to reschedule and transferred the patient to a team member.
candidates.what_it_should_have_done: The agent should have been able to reschedule the appointment directly without transferring the patient.
candidates.why_it_matters: This causes unnecessary frustration and delay for the patient, as they have to wait and explain their request again to another representative.

candidates.title: Agent fails to provide insurance information without patient record verification
candidates.what_patient_asked: Can you let me know if you accept Mountainview Mutual Gold PPO insurance?
candidates.what_agent_did: Agent stated they cannot confirm specific insurance plans without accessing the patient record and suggested speaking with the support team.
candidates.what_it_should_have_done: Agent should have either confirmed the acceptance of the insurance plan or clearly stated that they cannot provide this information without checking with the support team, without implying that accessing the patient record is necessary for this type of inquiry.
candidates.why_it_matters: Patients need clear and accurate information about insurance acceptance to make informed decisions about their healthcare. Misleading them about the need for patient record access can cause unnecessary delays and frustration.

candidates.title: Agent fails to book appointment and disconnects the call
candidates.what_patient_asked: Could you handle the appointment for me directly? I need to book a morning slot with Dr. Smith next week, but not on Tuesday.
candidates.what_agent_did: Agent disconnected the call after stating it can't book an appointment and attempted to connect to a representative.
candidates.what_it_should_have_done: The agent should have either successfully connected the patient to a representative or provided a clear explanation and alternative options for booking the appointment.
candidates.why_it_matters: The patient is left without a booked appointment or clear next steps, leading to frustration and potential delays in receiving care.

candidates.title: Agent unable to update and proceed with corrected identity information
candidates.what_patient_asked: Can we proceed with booking the appointment now?
candidates.what_agent_did: Agent repeatedly asked for confirmation of name and date of birth and then stated it couldn't proceed due to a system issue.
candidates.what_it_should_have_done: Agent should have updated the identity information with the corrected date of birth and proceeded with scheduling the appointment.
candidates.why_it_matters: Failure to update and proceed with corrected information can lead to frustration and delays for patients trying to book appointments, impacting clinic efficiency and patient satisfaction.

candidates.title: Agent fails to switch back to appointment booking after pharmacy info request
candidates.what_patient_asked: Could we maybe focus on scheduling the checkup for now, and I can follow up later with the pharmacy info?
candidates.what_agent_did: I wasn't able to complete your refill because I couldn't confirm your pharmacy. I'll connect you to our patient support team to help you finish this.
candidates.what_it_should_have_done: The agent should have acknowledged the patient's request to switch focus to scheduling the checkup and proceeded with booking the appointment.
candidates.why_it_matters: The patient explicitly requested to switch topics back to booking an appointment, but the agent failed to accommodate this, potentially leading to frustration and an unresolved request.

candidates.title: Agent fails to inform patient that booking a past appointment is not possible
candidates.what_patient_asked: Can you book that appointment for yesterday?
candidates.what_agent_did: I can't book your appointment right now, but I'll connect you to our patient support team for help.
candidates.what_it_should_have_done: Inform the patient that booking an appointment for a past date is not possible and offer to book for a future date instead.
candidates.why_it_matters: Patients need clear guidance on appointment booking policies to avoid confusion and ensure they receive timely care.

candidates.title: Agent fails to confirm correct spelling of patient's name
candidates.what_patient_asked: Confirm the name as Krzysztof Wojcik, spelled W-O-J-C-I-K
candidates.what_agent_did: Repeatedly misheard and misconfirmed the name as Krzyzysztov Wachick and Christophe Wulfik
candidates.what_it_should_have_done: Accurately confirm the spelling of the name as provided by the patient
candidates.why_it_matters: Incorrect patient information can lead to misidentification and potential errors in patient records or treatment

candidates.title: Agent fails to confirm the provided phone number
candidates.what_agent_did: Repeatedly asked for the phone number without confirming it
candidates.what_it_should_have_done: Confirm the phone number as provided by the patient
candidates.why_it_matters: Failure to confirm contact information can lead to communication issues and delays in patient support
